== English Virtual Original comparison ==
Artoo deployment moves from -2 to free. The captive Leia release no longer prevents Force retrieval this turn. Battle Order suspension/ignore stays keyed to captive Leia's site, and the explicit immunity to This Is Some Rescue expands to ‘May not be canceled’ with Alter immunity retained.
